` export PYTHONPATH=/Users/David/Dropbox/research/SALT3/salt3/training:$PYTHONPATH export PATH=/Users/David/Dropbox/research/SALT3/salt3/training:$PATH TrainSALT.py -c SALT.conf `

Brief working example for the pipeline: ``` In [2]: from salt3.pipeline.pipeline import *

In [3]: pipe = SALT3pipe(finput=’sampleinput_test.txt’)

In [4]: pipe.configure() Adding key COLOR=True in [FLAGS] Adding key STRETCH=True in [FLAGS] Adding key DIST_PEAK=0.0 in [COLOR] input file saved as: pipelinetest/TEST_BYOSED.params Load base sim input file.. SIMGEN_BYOSEDTEST.INPUT Adding key NGEN=5 Write sim input to file: pipelinetest/TEST_SIMGEN_BYOSEDTEST.INPUT Adding key snlist=exampledata/snana/data/SALT3TEST_SIMPLE.LIST in [iodata] Adding key waverange=2000,9200 in [trainparams] input file saved as: pipelinetest/TEST_SALT.conf

In [5]: pipe.run() ```
